falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes at a new 252-day high and is up at least 4.5% versus today's close within 14 days, with VIX closing at or below 13 on that day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price resolved into a confirmed upside breakout rather than an unresolved mini-top, so UNKNOWN phase and HOLD are wrong and the June 2019 mini-top analog failed.

falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes at least 6% below today's close within 14 days and VIX has a daily close at or above 25 on the same day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape confirmed a directional risk-off break, not an unknown/hold state; a decline of that size with that vol spike is a resolved top, not a 76% mini-top standoff.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 80 or at or below 30 within 14 days, and on that print fewer than 35% or more than 75% of S&P 500 members are above their 50-day moving average.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The moderate blowoff reading of 55 and the undecided phase are invalidated because momentum and breadth left the neutral band that justified HOLD and the partial mini-top match.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
